# final project definition

## Alternative Final Project

**What I’ll be doing:** I will be creating a computer vision prototype system for a robotic arm. (For TSA and STLP Comps) It will track with a live overlay.

**Programing Tie-in:** Creating the backend of the CV program using Python and some C++

**Game Design Tie-in:** CV can be used in games to track players in VR/AR environments.

**What I Need:**

1. Obsidian software (MD Program for my documentation)  
2. GitHub (sync to at home station)  
3. VSC
